summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 'Nueva solicitud de servicio' module. Verified 4-step wizard, validation, dependent dropdowns, service-type dynamic detail forms (Mantenimiento path E2E), success modal with SRV-2026-###### code, read-only Solicitud view with tracking bar + Historial, and persistence to Mis solicitudes via localStorage. Also verified mobile responsive layout (cards stack, mobile-menu-button visible). No browser alerts detected; all validation is inline via data-testid=error-*. All critical acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: generarCodigo() starts counter at 122+1=123 by default (SRV-2026-000123); matches spec but note counter persists across sessions in localStorage.

The 'select-ubicacion' element in Radix UI Select disables via aria-disabled inside SelectTrigger button; disabled attribute may not be exposed on the trigger via native attribute — verified via functional behaviour (placeholder shows 'Seleccione un cliente primero' before selection).
NuevaSolicitud.js is ~450 lines and mostly OK but the Step 2 block is dense — could be extracted into per-service sub-components for maintainability.
obtenerSolicitud fetches from localStorage on every render; fine for mock data.
seed_data_creation: One Mantenimiento solicitud created via UI (SRV-2026-000123) persisted in localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All wizard flows validated including Mantenimiento E2E, Ubicación dependent dropdown, Bogotá equipos filter (2 items: DISP-00034, DISP-00042), inline validation errors, review edit buttons, success modal SRV-2026-\d{6}, TrackingBar rendering, Mis solicitudes row navigation, and mobile stacking + mobile-menu-button. Only Mantenimiento path executed; Instalación & Auditoría flows structurally verified via code review (validate() function covers all three) but not clicked end-to-end.
